lead: A new dependency owes three things
body: : a `[workspace.dependencies]` line with a comment saying why that crate, `cargo deny check`, and `bun nv gen-attribution` (`rule:packaging/the-third-party-notice-is-generated-never-written-by-hand`). A license identifier new to the tree goes into both `deny.toml`'s allow list and `tools/nv/cmd/gen-attribution.ts`'s `PREFERENCE` in the same commit, because that command fails if the two disagree. The dependency sweep is a pass the user fires by hand (`rule:packaging/a-dependency-break-is-absorbed-never-forwarded`); never start it as a side effect.
